other_observed_failures.finding: The new loading fixture initially forwarded a held request after higher WebSocket IDs. Core correctly rejected it as id_reuse. Replaced the custom hold with the existing ordered transport hold; both final loading scenarios passed.

One phone run reported a null _panel_custom TypeError in native HA frontend _createPanel during the reload workflow. Its raw stack and failed outcome remain in that report. Repeating the same candidate and case passed without this diagnostic; no errors were suppressed. The transient native-host failure's root cause remains outside this fix.

limits: All schema-one machine fields remain complete. The 1000-member probe is still too large for Recorder, while its phone request stays compact. A universally bounded machine event needs a separate versioned-contract decision.
Short-link retention is 30 days from latest request, bounded to 1000 scopes and 20000 membership references. Unknown/expired scope never widens to all issues implicitly.
Measured phone service data precedes provider wrapping. Physical iOS/Android Companion use and provider acceptance/receipt are untested; the earlier mobile-app error's cause remains unproven.
Detected-fact events are outside this change. Existing consumer automations need the updated blueprint reimported or must prefer details_url.
